articles.title: Standard Chartered brings spot crypto trading to Dubai FX platform
articles.snippet: The bank is now offering institutional crypto spot trading in the region, bringing BTC and ETH onto the same eFX rails that institutions use to trade dollars and euros.

articles.title: Kraken parent Payward delays IPO to second quarter of 2027 at earliest
articles.snippet: The crypto exchange operator, which confidentially filed for a U.S. listing last November, had already put its IPO plans on hold amid difficult market conditions.

articles.title: New Jersey becomes first state to ask Supreme Court to weigh in on prediction markets
articles.snippet: After multiple appeals courts ruled differently about whether states can crack down on prediction markets' sports products, New Jersey asked SCOTUS to step in.

articles.title: Pencil Finance completes $1M onchain lending cycle for 6.6K students in Southeast Asia
articles.snippet: Pencil Finance said that its first-of-a-kind loan offered financing to 6,600 students in Southeast Asia who were underserved by traditional lenders.

articles.title: Standard Chartered launches spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in UAE
articles.snippet: Standard Chartered said it is the first major global bank to offer institutional access to spot Bitcoin and Ether trading in the UAE region.
